main_result.title: The exact predictable-weight envelope now has an append-oriented binary-run implementation that matches the frozen batch solver numerically; interrupted blocks can be made fail-closed by turning no-certified-result into the endpoint rather than missingness, and equal-process versus planned-exposure reliability must remain separate estimands.

incremental_implementation.design: For each mixture lambda, maintain a binary-counter set of immutable sorted breakpoint runs. Equal-size runs merge on append. Hinge suffix aggregates reconstruct S(c) and log D(c) without rebuilding a global segment table; guarded bisection solves the water-filling root.
incremental_implementation.asymptotic_accounting: Each observation participates in O(log n) merges; a hinge-stat query touches O(log n) live runs with binary search inside each, giving O(log^2 n) comparison work before fixed numerical-iteration factors.

incremental_validation.timing_scope: Local Python synthetic monitor only; not production timing and not a claim that every isolated endpoint query is faster than a one-time batch rebuild.

interrupted_block_contract.rule: Pre-admit B slots before outcomes. Completed canonical slots contribute their bounded mismatch score; interruption/deadline/no canonical result contributes 1. The block score is always observed and directly targets composite planned-exposure unreliability rather than a selected complete-case denominator.
interrupted_block_contract.stronger_bound_scope: If every interrupted slot has a coherent latent forced-completion mismatch in [0,1], missing-as-one also pointwise upper-bounds that latent full-completion mismatch. Do not claim this hypothetical estimand when attempt identity under forced completion is undefined.

informative_size_stress.analytic_example: With equally likely planned sizes 10 and 100 and mismatch rates 1% and 5%, equal-process mismatch is 3% while planned-exposure mismatch is 4.636%; reversing which size is less reliable gives 3% versus 1.364%.
informative_size_stress.synthetic_lognormal_gap: 500k-process synthetic stress gave 2.671% equal-process versus 4.154% exposure-weighted under positive size-outcome association, and 5.828% versus 4.339% when the association was reversed.
informative_size_stress.realized_size_guard: Outcome-dependent realized completed count is not a valid substitute for predictable planned size when targeting planned exposures.

importance_weight_boundary.rule: Predictable process/exposure weights declare how actually observed reliability is averaged; off-policy importance weights identify a counterfactual target policy. Predictability before reward alone does not make these estimands interchangeable.
importance_weight_boundary.public_alignment: Karampatziakis-Mineiro-Ramdas 2021 and Waudby-Smith et al. 2024 provide anytime-valid OPE under adaptive logging; those results do not relax the role-local w<=1 water-filling contract or turn random realized weights into planned-exposure weights.

main_result.public_data_structure_alignment: O'Neil et al. 1996 supplies the immutable sorted-run/geometric-merge data-structure pattern only. Statistical validity remains the role-local water-filling/e-process derivation.

measurement_validity_rules: Treat the incremental LSM-style implementation as a computational refactor under the same statistical contract, not as a stronger confidence sequence.
For infrastructure interruption, either make failure part of a predeclared composite endpoint or state explicit missingness/latent-outcome assumptions; never silently drop failed slots.
Name equal-process, equal-block, planned-exposure, completed-exposure, and counterfactual policy-value estimands separately. Weighting choices can reverse conclusions under informative size.
Do not use outcome-dependent final process size as a predictable weight.
Importance-weight OPE theorems do not justify plugging arbitrary random weights into the predictable-weight envelope.
If two reliability channels are both decision-critical, marginal 95% confidence sequences do not automatically imply 95% joint simultaneous coverage.
scope_guards: All timing and informative-size numbers produced in this invocation are local/synthetic stress results, not production measurements.
The incremental numerical comparison validates implementation agreement to floating-point tolerance, not the predecessor mathematical derivation itself.
The fail-closed composite score changes the endpoint intentionally by counting no-certified-result as unfavorable; it is not a missing-data correction for every hypothetical scientific question.
The OPE comparison is contractual/conceptual; no head-to-head numerical OPE implementation was completed in this invocation.
No forbidden semantic inputs were read and no connector-discovery mutation was performed.

frontier.action: Reduce the append-oriented prototype's memory/query overhead without changing its exact denominator: remove duplicated immutable payload representation, test a direct event-root search or cached root warm-start, and revalidate pathwise equality.
Implement the fail-closed planned-slot block score in a small streaming monitor and stress recovery after outage/deadline so pre-admitted failed slots cannot disappear from the denominator.

Build the deferred matched adaptive-sampling experiment: compare a published off-policy confidence sequence against the role-local predictable-weight CS only in special cases with mathematically identical targets, plus a wrong-target realized-weight counterexample.
Develop a joint decision rule for equal-process and planned-exposure reliability with an explicit simultaneous error budget rather than two uncoordinated marginal 95% channels.
Continue public trace search for repeated-inference token divergence propagating to deterministic score and paired sign.

frontier.exact_next_action: Refactor the incremental binary-run component to eliminate duplicated per-item payload/suffix storage and add a faster exact segment/root lookup or safe warm-start, then re-run pathwise equality and cadence benchmarks before making any deployment recommendation.
